O.outcome_detail: Target Zone Accuracy for adherence to Evaluate/Create versus Remember/Understand zones

cells.quote: As shown in Table 2, both architectures perform well when targeting “Higher” levels. By contrast, targeting “Lower” levels exposes a clear weakness, with overall accuracy dropping below 30% for both models.
cells.note: The study evaluates generated programming-task mutations rather than learners; learner and educational-setting fields are therefore not stated.
